eval: (async()=>{const c=document.getElementById('game');const r=c.getBoundingClientRect();const s=Game.scale,oy=Game.oy;const P=(dx,dy)=>({clientX:r.left+dx*s,clientY:r.top+oy+dy*s});const shoot=async(col)=>{const x=CONF.GRID.x+(col+0.5)*CONF.CELL_W,y=CONF.BORN.y;c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{pointerId:1,bubbles:true,...P(x,y)}));c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{pointerId:1,bubbles:true,...P(x,y-150)}));await new Promise(z=>setTimeout(z,60));c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',{pointerId:1,bubbles:true,...P(x,y-150)}));await new Promise(z=>setTimeout(z,900));};Game.model.data.inGuide=false;Game.grid.guideVisible=false;Game.grid.guideStep=-1;const log=[];for(const col of [2,2,2,1,1]){await shoot(col);log.push(JSON.stringify(Game.model.data.blocks));}return JSON.stringify({log,score:Game.model.data.score,next:Game.model.data.next,curMax:Game.model.data.curMax});})()
